You can get some pretty good deals with the shake and win anyway.

[Froot Loops] Hungry Jacks "vouchers" are a joke nowadays. No wonder their stores are always empty.
In saying this Maccas aren't far behind.
[WatchNerd] I remember when 2 Whoppers were $5.99 with a voucher. I'm much skinnier now.
[ozsb] Every time I eat a Whopper, I get the splats shortly after. It runs straight through me. Pretty sure it’s the mayo — if you can even call it that. I’m convinced it’s some synthetic blend of Miracle Whip. Even Mack Donald doesn’t do that 😂
The burgers have seriously degenerated at Hungry Jack’s ®….
[Aldonis] HJs is the only place that can give me diarrhoea 100% of the time even from something as ostensibly innocent as coffee
[BeauKilla] Breakfast shake and win or nothing these days
[ozsb] I find it abhorrent that practically everything on the Breakfast Shake & Win contains pork. Even the sausage muffin thing is pork. As someone who can’t eat pork for faith reasons, I find this really upsetting. At this point, it honestly feels almost deliberate.
Won’t say no to a hash brown though. The shake machine is never working at breakfast every time I’ve gone, so I can’t win anything anyway. 😂
Shout out to the manager Gabriel at Hungry Jack’s Queen Street, Brisbane. I won a couple of Breakfast Wraps a few weeks ago and he tried charging me to swap the sausage patties for burger patties, even though they had no eggs in stock as well. 😭
I remember there used to be a sign in every store that said, “The customer is always right.” If anyone has a picture of it, I would be forever indebted.
[solar eclipse] Who is Jack Cohen? Did you mean Jack Cowin?
What’s the connection to Israel? Is any of this relevant to some pretty mediocre coupons?
[ozsb] Co-win/Cohen, its all semantics.
Cohen is a very common Jewish surname, especially among Ashkenazi Jews.
I'm sure if you delve deep enough to our Canadian friend, you will find the answers you seek…
